title: Havoc / Elemental / Resto Druid vs TSG
summary: Do not pick a target at the gates. Kite, purge, and swap between the Warrior and the DK until one of them is dry.

sections.title: This comp kites and swaps; it does not train
sections.body: Counts: Warrior 8, DK 7, Druid 5. Nobody on their side is thin, so a named target is a target you cannot finish. Both your DPS kite well and both have AoE burst that lines up with AoE control. Their Resto Druid takes real time to heal two targets at once, and your Shaman can purge. Swap between the Warrior and the DK until one list is empty.

sections.title: Kite — the default state, not a retreat

steps.note: 30s. The cheapest way to buy distance.
180s. Use it to reset, not to survive a go.

sections.title: The go — only when both their melee are stacked

steps.note: 45s. Only when they are stacked — it is the whole trigger.
40s. Drop it into the Nova so the Druid stays hidden.
Instant, on their healer, the same global as the Nova.
120s. The slowest term you hold; this is the cadence.

sections.title: What the Death Knight answers with

steps.note: 40s, and your whole comp is magic. Back every go.
180s. Party-wide — it blunts the go, not the target.
180s, party-wide. Count it against the go.
30s. He leaves the Nova rather than eating it.
